FavoriteMeal.description: Favourite meals, by name, with their current values.

FavoriteMeal.SaveFavoriteInput.description: Keeps what was logged in a meal of a day as a favourite.

FavoriteMeal.jsonld.description: Favourite meals, by name, with their current values.

Food.description: Searches the foods the user can log (CIQUAL and their own), best matches first.

Food.ConfirmProductInput.description: Keeps a scanned product: as Open Food Facts gives it (shared, values read again from the source), or corrected (the user's own food, with its barcode).

Food.CustomFoodInput.description: Creates a custom food (a packaged product, a food missing from CIQUAL).

Food.jsonld.description: Searches the foods the user can log (CIQUAL and their own), best matches first.

Food.jsonld_noid.description: A catalogue food, or one of the user's own.

Health.description: Readiness of the API and its dependencies. Answers 503 with the same body when degraded.

Health.jsonld.description: Readiness of the API and its dependencies. Answers 503 with the same body when degraded.

JournalEntry.CorrectEntryInput.description: Corrects the quantity, or moves the entry to another meal or day; answers with that day.

JournalEntry.LogFavoriteInput.description: Logs every item of a favourite meal in a meal of a day, in one go. Answers with the day.

JournalEntry.LogFoodInput.description: Logs a quantity of a food in a meal; the food's values are copied into the entry. Answers with the day.

JournalEntry.LogFoodsInput.description: Logs several foods in one meal at once, all or nothing (a Meal Builder proposal). Answers with the day.

JournalEntry.NutritionDay.description: Logs a quantity of a food in a meal; the food's values are copied into the entry. Answers with the day.

JournalEntry.NutritionDay.jsonld.description: Logs a quantity of a food in a meal; the food's values are copied into the entry. Answers with the day.

MealBuilder.description: Up to 3 meals, from the user's usual foods and a few staples, that fill what is left of the day (or of one meal, per the meal split).

MealBuilder.jsonld.description: Up to 3 meals, from the user's usual foods and a few staples, that fill what is left of the day (or of one meal, per the meal split).

MealSplit.description: How the daily calories are spread over meals.

MealSplit.jsonld.description: How the daily calories are spread over meals.

NutritionAverages.description: Daily averages over the last 7 or 30 days (today included), over the days that were logged.

NutritionAverages.jsonld.description: Daily averages over the last 7 or 30 days (today included), over the days that were logged.

NutritionDay.description: The journal of a calendar day (YYYY-MM-DD, the user's local day).

NutritionDay.jsonld.description: The journal of a calendar day (YYYY-MM-DD, the user's local day).

NutritionTarget.description: Target history, most recent first (the first one effective on or before today is in force).

NutritionTarget.TargetInput.description: Sets new daily targets from today (or tomorrow). With the estimate they came from, they are recorded as "estimate" when unchanged, "manual" otherwise.

NutritionTarget.jsonld.description: Target history, most recent first (the first one effective on or before today is in force).

NutritionTarget.jsonld_noid.description: Daily targets from a day on. Never edited: each change is a new entry of the history.

PasswordChange.description: Changes the password; every other device is signed out.

PasswordReset.description: Sets a new password from an emailed link and signs every device out.

PasswordResetRequest.description: Emails a reset link if a verified account uses this address. Always 202: accounts are never revealed.

Recipe.description: The user's recipes, by name, with their composition.

Recipe.RecipeInput.description: Creates a recipe (1 to 50 ingredients, 1 to 50 servings).

Recipe.jsonld.description: The user's recipes, by name, with their composition.

RecoveryCodes.description: Activates two-factor authentication with a first valid code; returns the recovery codes.

RecoveryCodes.CodeInput.description: Activates two-factor authentication with a first valid code; returns the recovery codes.

RecoveryCodes.PasswordConfirmation.description: Replaces the recovery codes (password required); previous ones stop working.

RecoveryCodes.jsonld.description: Activates two-factor authentication with a first valid code; returns the recovery codes.

Session.description: Signed-in devices, most recently active first.

Session.jsonld.description: Signed-in devices, most recently active first.

SignIn.description: Checks email and password; signs the device in, or asks for the second factor.

SignIn.SecondFactorInput.description: Completes a pending sign-in with an authenticator code or a recovery code.

SignIn.SignInInput.description: Checks email and password; signs the device in, or asks for the second factor.

SignIn.jsonld.description: Checks email and password; signs the device in, or asks for the second factor.

TwoFactorSetup.description: Starts enrolling an authenticator app (password required, email must be verified).

TwoFactorSetup.PasswordConfirmation.description: Starts enrolling an authenticator app (password required, email must be verified).

TwoFactorSetup.jsonld.description: Starts enrolling an authenticator app (password required, email must be verified).

tags.description:
Spec §20: scan → Symfony → product database → normalised proposal → user confirmation. A scan
saves nothing; POST /nutrition/barcode/confirm does, once the user agreed.

tags.name: MealBuilder
tags.description: Meal Builder (spec §28): what is left, and meals that fill it. Add one with POST /nutrition/entries/batch.

tags.name: FavoriteMeal
tags.description: A meal eaten often, logged again in one go (POST /nutrition/favorite-meals/{id}/log).

tags.name: Food
tags.description: Resource 'Food' operations.

tags.name: JournalEntry
tags.description: Journal writes. Each answers with the NutritionDay it changed (read an entry through its day).

tags.name: NutritionAverages
tags.description:
Daily averages over the logged days of the last 7 or 30 days: a day with nothing logged is
left out rather than counted as a day without eating.

tags.name: NutritionDay
tags.description:
A day of the food journal, meal by meal, against the target in force that day.
Journal writes (JournalEntry) answer with the day they changed, so the screen is redrawn from one response.

tags.name: Recipe
tags.description: A dish made of foods. Its values follow its foods; journal entries keep those of the day they were logged.

tags.name: EnergyEstimate
tags.description: The calculation shown step by step: BMR → expenditure → surplus/deficit → targets.

tags.name: MealSplit
tags.description: Percent of the day's calories planned per meal; the five shares add up to 100.

tags.name: NutritionTarget
tags.description: Daily targets from a day on. Never edited: each change is a new entry of the history.
